input.profile: experience: novice|intermediate|expert; preference: concise|detailed; completed: unique module-name list
input.grid_assets: SCADA-style telemetry JSON envelope with synthetic=true and assets: asset_id, critical, neighbors, timestamp, voltage_kv, emissions {value, unit, source}
input.outage_reports: list of outage_id, asset_id, life_threat, critical_service, customers_affected, priority

shared_schema.output: schema_version, status, synthetic, protection, onboarding {experience, preference, steps, next_module, ready}, entities {meter_readings, grid_assets, outage_reports}
shared_schema.validation: One validate function used by run and CLI; exact object fields; duplicate JSON fields rejected; typed and finite quantities; identifiers match SYN-[A-Z][A-Z0-9-]*; valid references; reciprocal topology; UTC intervals; required emissions unit/source; mandatory safety priorities and onboarding prerequisite closure.

cross_stage_handoffs: Parse shared input -> validate all entities and profile -> build deterministic guided onboarding -> project protected entities into one output envelope

behavior.adaptive: Novices receive prerequisite seasonal training. Intermediate and expert learners skip introductory seasonal training, never protection or safety. Detailed preference includes expanded explanations.
behavior.prerequisites: protection -> seasonal_basics (novice) -> meter_readings; protection -> grid_assets and safety_rules; grid_assets + safety_rules -> outage_triage
behavior.progress: completed is caller-supplied simulated progress, not authenticated certification. Steps are completed, available, or locked. next_module is the first available module; ready requires every selected module completed.
behavior.safety_rules: P1 life threat; otherwise P2 critical service; otherwise P3 >=100 customers; otherwise P4. Contradictory supplied priorities are rejected.
behavior.protection: All entity identifiers are deterministically pseudonymized using namespaced SHA-256 prefixes. Emissions provenance scrubs known identifiers. Error messages never interpolate submitted identifiers. Raw synthetic inputs remain local plaintext.
behavior.emissions: Finite nonnegative quantity with kgCO2e or tCO2e and nonempty source; units preserved without aggregation.
behavior.fixtures: Explicitly synthetic reciprocal substation/device topology, winter Northern Hemisphere household interval consumption, fictitious asset and meter IDs.
behavior.determinism: No random, current-time-dependent, provider, network, or LLM operations.

test_outcomes.cli_example: passed: one JSON object, status ok, exit 0
test_outcomes.cli_errors: passed: file, usage, invalid JSON and validation errors produce status error and exit 2
